upsert.title: Enveda CASMI 2026 — Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
upsert.summary: Online Kaggle ML competition: predict 2-D chemical structures from mass spectrometry data. Entry (rules acceptance) by 7 Dec 2026 23:59 UTC; final submissions close 14 Dec 2026 23:59 UTC.
upsert.eligibility: Anyone with a Kaggle account aged 18+ (or age of majority); excluded: Crimea, Donetsk/Luhansk, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and sanctioned persons. Solo or teams up to 5.
notes: Details confirmed from Kaggle's announcement and a detailed listing page; Kaggle rules tab is binding.
